## Finalize Consent v10
Called only by Consent Sweep, one Request ID at a time. Re-reads the row; Stage records progress (HOLD_SNAPSHOT, HOLD_DELETED, PLACING, PLACED) so the next sweep finishes or unwinds a run that died. The hold is copied to the row before it is deleted, the booking is checked, and a failed booking restores the hold; if that fails the row is NEEDS_ATTENTION and #approvals is told.

parameters.jsCode:
const P = $('Plan').first().json;
return [{ json: { 'Request ID': P.requestId, 'Stage': 'HOLD_SNAPSHOT', 'Hold Snapshot': JSON.stringify($('Check Hold').first().json.snapshot) } }];
return [{ json: { 'Request ID': $('Plan').first().json.requestId, 'Stage': 'PLACED', 'Placement Event Id': $('Check Placed').first().json.placementId || '' } }];

const o = (() => { try { return $('Outcome').first().json; } catch (e) { return {}; } })();
return [{ json: { request_id: $('Plan').first().json.requestId, status: (o.fin || {}).Status || 'UNCHANGED' } }];
return [{ json: { status:'FAILED', reason: $('Plan').first().json.reason, human: $('Plan').first().json.notifyReq || 'The request could not be completed.' } }];

## Finalize Consent
On an APPROVED consent request: relocate the incumbent via Move Booking (as the incumbent, owner=true), then PLACE the requester - by Move (move-preempt) or Book (book-preempt), per placeTarget. All-or-nothing move-first. Marks the Consent Requests row DONE/FAILED and notifies both. Logic mirrors workflows/drafts/consent/finalize.js (33/33). executeWorkflow/Sheets-update wiring validates at the coordinated live QA. Inactive until wired.
